delivered.statement: Q2: 1.5% YoY, 1.2% sequential constant currency; H1: 1.9% constant currency
10.5% of total revenue, growing 29% sequentially; up from 8.2% prior quarter
Q2: $5.2bn TCV, 62% net new; H1: $8.8bn with 28% YoY growth, 62% net new
$2bn net new seven-year deal with financial services client; $1bn renewal mega deal
21% in Q2, flat sequentially; H1 at 21% midpoint of guided range

themes: AI revenue acceleration (29% sequential, 10.5% of total revenue mix)
Mega deals with AI-led business transformation driving multi-year visibility
Pricing pressure and competitive intensity; disciplined deal selection by economics
AI productivity deflation in legacy services (finite cycle impact)
Project Maximus operational initiatives sustaining 21% margin profile
Offshoring shift reducing onsite mix to 22.6%; client cost optimization focus
risks: Geopolitical tensions, inflation, shifting priorities causing cautious client spending
AI productivity deflating traditional services revenue; unknown duration of transition
Sustained pricing pressure from competitive intensity limiting pricing expansion
Macro uncertainties (interest rates, tariffs) constraining Global 2000 client budgets

analyst_pushback.question: Why narrow guidance given strong mega deals and healthy pipeline?
analyst_pushback.response: AI deflation, competitive pricing pressure, 2% offshoring/deal walk headwind offset TCV strength

analyst_pushback.question: How much AI revenue is new versus reclassified existing work?
analyst_pushback.response: Revenue is new work falling within six Hexagon areas not deliverable pre-AI, like legacy modernization

analyst_pushback.question: Are AI deal margins similar to overall company 21% margin profile?
analyst_pushback.response: Margin not disclosed separately; getting good pricing; clients seeing strong value realization

analyst_pushback.question: Is pricing pressure broad-based across portfolio or isolated to specific sectors?
analyst_pushback.response: Across client base on AI productivity demands; some asks exceed our economic return thresholds

tone_evidence: Confident on AI momentum (29% growth) and mega deal wins; cautious on macro, pricing pressure, discretionary spend weakness
